note: Fixed before the first E run (stages/E.md section 1). Values marked measuredAtE0 are the split arm measured on origin/main at E0, times the stated factor; record the measured number and its source run here before the branch arm runs. A value changed after a diff is seen is a new run, not an amendment.

foregroundSearchP95Ceiling.rule: split p95 x 1.10 per mode (hybrid, lexical)

agentLoopApiP95Ceiling.rule: split p95 x 1.10 over admission-loop.mjs calls

admissionRejectionCeiling.countedBy: harness oracle on the wire; timeout or 5xx is failure

indexingProgressFraction.rule: branch chunks/s >= 0.90 x split under the same foreground load

soak.workload: bulk indexing plus the scripted agent loop plus reconfigure cycles
soak.rule: record each window separately; never report the two windows as one continuous run

hangParameters.rule: interval x missCount >= 3 x worst observed safepoint pause in E4; interval >= 10 s

d2Deferred.effect: D2 is post-merge; the verification-profile boot row of development-cost.md is recorded as not measured
d2Deferred.sessionGateAndCursorCaps: not E values; D2 post-merge acceptance
